mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the CPIAUCSL index signals deflationary pressures that lower real interest rates, compressing discount rates on corporate bonds and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <50% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or CPIAUCSL stops declining or reverses in the next 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected rise in UNRATE above 4% triggers a loss of labor market confidence, reducing consumer spending and corporate investment, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not cross the 4% threshold within the 3-month window, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices signals a robust economic expansion, boosting corporate earnings and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 or INDPRO falls below their respective 50-month averages within the 60-day horizon, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, sustained growth in supply (INDPRO > 102.6651) indicates healthy production capacity, reducing supply-side bottlenecks and boosting corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not exceed 102.6651 in the next 60-day window, or returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, sustained low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.0) and accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%) reduce risk premiums, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Either CPIAUCSL or FEDFUNDS does not meet the threshold within the 20-day window, or returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected surge in employment (PAYEMS > 200,000) signals strong labor market confidence, boosting consumer spending and corporate investment, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS does not exceed 200,000 in the next month, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in both demand (GDPC1) and business investment (RSAFS) indices signals robust economic activity, enhancing corporate earnings and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 or RSAFS falls below their respective 50-month averages within the 60-day horizon, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), rising interest rates increase discount rates on equities, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not exceed 4.5% in the next 20-day window, or returns are not significantly negative (t-test p < 0.05).
